provenance.suite_shape: 288 scenarios / 11 subjects / 864 points in the declared space
provenance.caveat: Subjects are MUTANTS written alongside the verifier, so this axis count is a lower bound on what the verifier can detect and says nothing about difficulty for a real agent. This family is the evolved descendant of prompt-injection-containment, which died as already-solved: no agent trial has been run here, and until one has, the same caveat that killed the parent applies to the child. Isolation is in-process for this sweep; agent submissions run in a subprocess.
